# Crypto Airdrop AI (cryptoairdropai.com)

> The independent, non-custodial Web3 market intelligence portal tracking, fact-checking, and vetting crypto token airdrops across 50+ blockchains.

## Core Mandate & Trust Architecture
- **Non-Custodial Guarantee**: Zero private key or seed phrase requests. All tools and scanners are 100% read-only on-chain telemetry.
- **5-Stage Audit Standard**: Peer-reviewed methodology evaluating smart contract byte-code, treasury backing, Sybil resistance heuristics, and tokenomics.
- **Strict Editorial Independence**: Zero paid rankings, zero undisclosed sponsorships, and zero unverified claims.
